titles.native: きらめき☆プロジェクト

description:
A mysterious giant robot easily defeated many powerful robots from many countries. The whole world is wondering what country made him. Aside from those battles, 3 princesses are living in a far little kingdom, and one of them has constructed her precious friend.

(Source: Anime News Network, edited)
